declared: kT declares AOI-2226 refractive-index matching and independently switchable clear/glare/dark plus visible/NIR modulation. NOT demonstrated at full scale. Zero numeric optical/IR cooling performance credited; worst Venus solar aperture heat explicitly included. Transparent dome and AOI thermal expansion/differential heat flux remain OPEN.

Torch heat package (kT, 2026-10-25): each pellet is wrapped in a shell of remass that soaks up the burn and leaves as exhaust. The shell must let no more than ~358 ppm of the burn's energy escape as light, counting its own glow (the reactor face's 10 MW/m2 limit); the design value is 180 ppm. With the model's other assumptions (torch/torch_heat_inputs.json: light 40% of fusion energy; He3-rich, spin-polarised fuel with 0.76% neutrons, 85% absorbed by the shell; plume contact 1e-4 of charged energy; coil shield transmission 1e-3), 1.40 GW reaches hot structure and 0.48 MW the magnet coils at 12.6 TW of fusion. These are assumptions, not results. Replaces v0.5.1's 387 MW (34 ppm) torch-leak gap.

Hot fins run for life at 1750 K. Lithium heat pipes have run in lab tests to ~1,500 K and briefly ~1,800 K; years at 1750 K with burn cycling and neutron exposure is an engineering extrapolation (a technology milestone), not new physics. Fallback: 1,500 K fins, ~49 m span, ~30 t, still inside the reserve.

TWO D-He3 house reactors each 50MW net, 10% minimum on line, 40kW/kg net and 75% direct conversion; 2226 engineering declarations, not tested physical hardware. One surviving unit supports known Metric HARD cryo 34.8MW at 1300K plus separately declared, explicitly NON-CANON 5MW field/control, E1 0.98×0.96 PMAD losses, and ordinary loads. Relational plant is consumer ONLY, Metric bank never a source. Environmental correction power remains OPEN.

At worst-case sunlight, the open crown adds ~100 kW of solar heating to habitat. In heat-pump-failed or cold-running passive backup the 16 Strata gores MUST CLOSE; clear/glare/dark AOI states may not be credited as heat rejection or solar exclusion. Solar absorption/IR-band partition and AOI switching performance are not physically qualified.

Cold running (rev 7, F5 provisional item F5-TE-01): the tunable flanks drop from emissivity 0.85 to 0.1, so at the same skin temperature they radiate 12% as much. Heat is held, not removed: habitat heat 58.1 kW (x1.25), plus plant standby 10.0 kW and cryo standby 10.0 kW, less 7.1 kW still leaking through 177 m2 of low-e skin at 290 K warms the 50 t of protected water by 15 K in about 11.7 h (ideal no-standby ceiling 17.1 h). House reactors OFF; flywheel inefficiency 3.5 kW included. ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION (screening placeholders 10+10 kW, NOT sourced or qualified); editable, replace with measured/engineering budget. Then the ship must open the strakes or switch the flanks back to normal. Detailed load-cycle variation, cryo plant duty, tank thermal coupling, and reserve storage remain open. The metallic look in the viewer is a proposed optical property.
notes: Habitat heat 146.6 kW for 10 people; heat pump to 1300 K needs 1021 kW (Carnot fraction 0.5).
Torch burns: strakes open to 4.0 m (73 MW); full 24 m span (387 MW) is no longer needed for the torch. At 4.0 m they shine 1.46 MW onto the hull coating.

Torch heat model (torch/, non-governing): same 11.36 TW jet from 12.6 TW of fusion, pulsed at about 1-10 Hz (0.3-3 kt per pulse). Light escape the face can take: ~358 ppm; model 180 ppm. Hot-fin capacity is computed here with certify's own 2D view factor; torch/fin_layout.py (numpy, 3.0 m body) gives a slightly higher figure.
Dedicated D-He3 house power modeled separately. Metric bank and relational plant generate no power. See single table ship_power_budget.json; listed deficits are not retired by PASS-DECLARED.
